0.content: Dvalin is the Anemo Dragon Sovereign and the Dragon of the East of the Four Winds, and Venti's friend for around two thousand years. A newborn dragon whose size caused accidental havoc, he was drawn by the music of the Holy Lyre der Himmel. Barbatos calmly sang of his beauty while people panicked, then taught him human speech and song and taught Mondstadt not to fear him. Five hundred years ago Barbatos called him to fight the black dragon Durin. Dvalin killed it but swallowed its poisoned blood and slept in Decarabian's ruined tower. When he woke, the people had forgotten him and the poison tormented him. The Abyss Order convinced him his god had abandoned him and drove him to attack Mondstadt as "Stormterror". Venti and the Traveler purified him. Afterward Venti refused to command him: "freedom, if demanded of you by an archon, is really no freedom at all."

1.content: Barbatos and Morax are the last two of the original Seven and old friends of a lopsided kind. The first time Barbatos descended on Liyue, Morax assumed a crisis and prepared to help; Barbatos tossed him a bottle: "Here's some wine from Mondstadt. Care for a taste?" He kept visiting with endless questions, and the first Seven began gathering in Liyue. Venti tried forging Morax's seal as a prank and never fooled him, and gleefully quotes "epic poems of days gone by" calling the Geo Archon "a brutish blundering buffoon". Zhongli sniffs that the bard "reeks of wine" and is "a disgrace to the arts", yet still remembers how those wines tasted.

key: the boy who wished to see birds
2.content: In storm-walled Old Mondstadt the wind spirit befriended a boy who played the lyre, dreamed of writing the greatest poem and had never seen the sky: "I do so wish to see the birds in flight." The spirit fetched him an eagle's feather. The boy raised a rebellion against Decarabian and the spirit joined him. The tyrant fell, but the boy died before Venti could give him the feather. On ascending, Barbatos remade himself in the boy's likeness so he could play the lyre the boy loved, and founded a free Mondstadt believing the boy "would have wanted to live in such a place."

3.comment: Venti: Signora and the Anemo Gnosis
3.content: After Dvalin was saved, Signora, Eighth of the Fatui Harbingers, ambushed Venti outside the Favonius Cathedral. She froze him in place, called him Mondstadt's "rodent ruler" and slapped him when he talked back. Then she plunged her hand into his chest and pulled out the Anemo Gnosis, a chess-piece-like crystal, while her agents knocked out the Traveler. Venti recovered at the Windrise oak and explained to the Traveler what a Gnosis is: an Archon's internal focus that resonates with Celestia, unlike a mortal's Vision.

4.content: Venti met the Traveler in the Whispering Woods, when their sudden Anemo power broke his healing link with Dvalin. He soon realised their unique power could purify Dvalin's corrupted tears, and the two saved Mondstadt together. He calls them his muse, wants the world's bards to tell the Traveler's tales, and says wherever he roams, it must be with them. He named them the "Windborne Outlander". His parting advice, repeated years later, is that "the journey itself has meaning".

5.comment: Venti: Holy Lyre der Himmel, Der Frühling and the fake Vision
5.content: Archons do not need Visions, but Barbatos wanted to roam freely as Venti, so he made a glass ornament that looks like an Anemo Vision. It has no power, and he jokes he can make you a matching one. Too lazy to carry a lyre, he lets it turn into his wooden lyre, Der Frühling. His divine instrument, the Holy Lyre der Himmel, is a Church relic used at Ludi Harpastum. During the Stormterror crisis he asked Sister Gotelinde for it, introducing himself as Barbatos; she dismissed him as a bard full of nonsense. The Fatui stole it, Diluc's raid recovered it, and its strings were restored with purified tears, but it broke when an Abyss Mage intervened. Venti "repaired" it with an illusion just long enough to hand it to a horrified Barbara.
